instructions: Complete the table below. Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the passage for each answer.

items.prompt: Overall: Ten weeks in the summer; (15) ........ places across all departments
items.evidence: Places are limited to fifteen interns across all departments.
items.explanation: Paragraph C of Text A says places are limited to fifteen interns across all departments; that is why the answer is 'fifteen'.

yeniden_uretim.kaynak_prompt: GT2 okuma - isaretli kalem elden gecirme (2026-08-18)
yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Eligibility: Undergraduate on a suitable degree, free to work here for the whole placement with no need for (15) ........
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Applicants must be enrolled in a relevant degree, such as economics, accounting or business studies, and hold the right to work in the country for the full ten weeks without requiring sponsorship.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Esdizim kilidi: bosluk 'calisma hakki' kosulunun ucuna aciliyordu ve bu kosulu soran her cerceve ayni kavrami veriyor. Anlam duzeyi olcumunde model uc turda 'sponsorship / a visa / sponsorship' verdi, yani dogru kavrami parcasiz buldu. Onceki turda 'answer alani korunur' gerekcesiyle kalem oldugu gibi birakilmisti; bu turda hedefi degistirme izni oldugu icin kapatildi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Bosluk kaliptan cikarilip metnin kendi sectigi bir SAYIYA acildi: kanit A metni A/2'den C/3'e (kontenjan) tasindi, cevap 'fifteen' oldu. Kok metinsiz okundugunda ('___ places across all departments') hicbir tek aday cikmiyor. Satirin basligi da degisti ('Eligibility' -> 'Overall'), cunku uygunluk kosullari artik tabloda degil 21. coktan secmeli kaleminde soruluyor; boylece iki gorev arasinda bilgi ortusmesi de kalkti. Butce: A metninin A paragrafi bosaldi (21. kalem oraya tasindi ve yalniz A/1'i kullaniyor), C paragrafi uc soruya cikti (18, 19, 15) -- sinirin icinde, C/3 daha once bostu.

items.prompt: Written stage: Form filled in online and an up-to-date CV uploaded by 28 February, plus a (16) ........ statement explaining your interest
items.evidence: Submit a 300-word statement explaining your interest in the placement.
items.explanation: Text A, paragraph B says applicants must submit a 300-word statement explaining their interest in the placement; so the answer is '300-word'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Written stage: Form filled in online, an up-to-date (16) ........ , and 300 words on why you want the placement
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Complete the online application form and upload a current CV by 28 February.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Is basvurusu baglaminda 'guncel bir ___ yukleyin' satirinin tek yaygin tamamlamasi CV; sozcuk basvuru surecinin kendisinden cikiyor, pasajdan degil. Satiri yeniden yazmak bunu degistirmiyor. E6 bu yuvayi ayni paragrafin baska bir kosuluna (300 kelimelik gerekce metni ya da 28 Subat son basvuru tarihi) capalamali.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Eski satir B/2'ye capaliydi ve cevap ('CV') basvuru surecinin kendisinden cikiyordu, pasajdan degil. Yeni satir B/2'ye hic degmiyor: kanit B/3'e, gerekce metninin uzunluguna tasindi; CV ve son basvuru tarihi artik VERILEN bilgi olarak satirda duruyor, sorulmuyor. Istenen uzunluk ilana ozgu bir sayi.

items.prompt: Interview: A (17) ........ , offered only to candidates kept on after the first round
items.evidence: Applicants shortlisted after the written stage will be invited to a video interview during March.
items.explanation: Paragraph B of the passage says candidates shortlisted after the written stage are invited to a video interview during March; that is why the answer is 'video interview'.

items.prompt: Offer: Those chosen are given (18) ........ to accept the place
items.evidence: Successful applicants are notified by the end of April and must confirm their place within ten working days.
items.explanation: Paragraph C of the passage says successful applicants must confirm their place within ten working days; that is why the answer is 'ten working days'.

items.prompt: Placement starts: £2,100 a month; anyone moving home for the period also receives a (19) ........
items.evidence: The internship begins on the first Monday of July and includes a salary of £2,100 per month, plus a travel allowance for those relocating temporarily.
items.explanation: Paragraph C of the passage says a travel allowance is given, in addition to the salary, to those relocating temporarily; that is why the answer is 'travel allowance'.

items.prompt: During the placement: A short performance review at the (20) ........ mark, and a final one before leaving
items.evidence: Interns complete a short performance review at the five-week mark and a final review before departure; strong performers may be invited to apply for the graduate programme the following year, though this is not guaranteed and depends on business need.
items.explanation: Text A, paragraph D says interns complete a short performance review at the five-week mark and a final review before departure; so the answer is 'five-week'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: During the placement: A (20) ........ from the intern's own department sees them once a week
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Each intern is paired with a mentor from their assigned department who meets with them weekly throughout the ten weeks.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Kanit cumlesinin butun icerigi ('kendi biriminden biriyle eslestirilir, on hafta boyunca haftada bir gorusur') Ingiliz is dunyasinda dogrudan 'mentor' rolunu tanimliyor; satirdan hangi ayrinti cikarilirsa cikarilsin kalan cerceve ayni sozcugu veriyor. E6 bu yuvayi staj suresinin baska bir ayrintisina (aylik ucret ya da on haftalik sure) tasimali.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Eski satir D/1'e capaliydi ve cumlenin butun icerigi ('kendi biriminden biriyle eslestirilir, on hafta boyunca haftada bir gorusur') dogrudan 'mentor' rolunu tanimliyordu. Yeni satir D/1'e hic degmiyor: kanit D/2'ye, ara degerlendirmenin zamanina tasindi. Bu tarih programa ozgu; on haftalik surenin ortasi olmasi da zorunlu degil, dolayisiyla hesapla turetilemez.
